QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_21

question.text: Cat I and II AIFs are treated as:

answer.text: Pass-through for investment income; business income taxed at fund level
Same as Cat III for taxation

explanation.text: The Logic: Category I and Category II AIFs defined as Investment Funds receive tax pass-through treatment under Section 115UB for income other than business income; that income is taxed in the investors' hands. Business income of such funds is taxed at the fund level and is exempt in the hands of investors. The Trap: Treating Cat I/II as fully taxable, fully exempt, or identical to Cat III ignores the specific pass-through and business-income carve-out that defines their taxation regime. Note: Based on NISM Series XIX-A workbook pages 253-255, which describe Section 115UB pass-through treatment and fund-level taxation of business income for Category I/II AIFs.
